findings.detail: The catalog category is mapped to D60 and remains unselected; D60 independently names Todoist but no concrete additional task provider.
CONTRACTS.md line 311 supersedes D66 conditional release wording; route is superseded.

knownLimits: The catalog/register crosswalk is source preparation only; no CLI, connector, credential, runtime, research attestation, or assigned-rung acceptance proof was collected.

D66 remains in the older register with a conditional R2 release gate at line 269, while authoritative CONTRACTS.md line 311 drops Composio in favor of local connectors; the visible supersession conflict keeps registerRouteConsistent false.

The generic “Other task apps” category at sources.md line 3785 maps to the §9.47 D60 category and remains unselected; D60 at register line 263 names Todoist and does not define a concrete additional provider.

contractSupersession.sourceText: | Third-party services (Johan, 2026-10-04) | **Build it ourselves unless it's impossible from this Mac.** Kept: Backblaze B2 (off-site backup storage) and Healthchecks.io (outside dead-man's-switch). **Dropped:** Grafana Cloud → our own status page in the Toy web app + `toy doctor` + local OTLP/log files; Composio → our own connectors via `toy new connector`; Bitwarden Secrets Manager → macOS Keychain owned by `_toy_control` (secret broker unchanged; recovery copies of the restic password live in Johan's Apple Passwords). Any spec text naming the dropped services is superseded. |
